name: Konoha Noa
source:
"What's a mahou shounen? I didn't hear you!"

She's wanted to be a mahou shoujo ever since she was little, but she was too bad at magic so she decided to become a master. She is considerate of her surroundings and values cooperation, but is scary when mad.

She's a mahou shoujo otaku. She's powerful and has a secret ability.

Likes: Mahou shoujo, anime
Dislikes: Ghosts
Power: Secret

[Translated from [url=http://dearmagi.caerux.com/character/]official website[/url]]
